svg.text: Either lug of each footswitch goes to its Seed3 place; the other lug is on the ground-chain page.
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
pg-a footswitch: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 24
pg-b footswitch: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 25
pg-c footswitch: either lug -> Seed3 socket place 10
